episodes.title: Victoria’s cult inquiry: What advocates and survivors are saying
episodes.description:
Parliamentary inquiry gathers further evidence on how high-control groups operate—and the impact they have on the community. 

Additional public hearings have been held, bringing in a wide range of voices, including tertiary sector organisations, the federal charities regulator, and people with lived experience. Their insights are helping build a clearer picture of how these groups operate, who they target, and what protections might be needed moving forward.

episodes.title: Witnesses share insights on coercive high-control groups
episodes.description:
The parliamentary inquiry looking into the recruitment methods and impacts of cults and organised fringe groups has heard from a range of witnesses, including people with lived experience, cult advocacy and support groups, and representatives of various faith organisations. This snapshot looks at some of the evidence provided, with more updates to come from hearings that have been held so far. 

Keep up to date with the inquiry by visiting the Committee’s website at https://www.parliament.vic.gov.au/cofg.
